lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11-12 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines traverse the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section but compacts slightly towards the posterior transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines on the anterior torso terminate before reaching the ventral boundary, particularly the second and third lines from the shoulder.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct, high-contrast white spots are visible on the lateral surface of the right haunch, positioned roughly parallel to the tail base.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a spiral, lyrate trajectory with a clear posterior-lateral curve visible from the skull base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ochre/tan coloration on all visible lower limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints, creating a sharp contrast with the dark brown upper pelage; distinctive white patch visible on the lower neck/throat area.
